description: This file defines a wrapper class around Android's MediaCodec API, facilitating media decoding operations by managing buffers, callbacks, and configuration for video decoding.

classes.name: MediaCodecWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that simplifies the interaction with Android's MediaCodec API, managing buffer queues, callbacks, and media format configuration for decoding media streams.

methods.name: fromVideoFormat
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of MediaCodecWrapper configured for decoding a specific MediaFormat and rendering surface.

methods.name: stopAndRelease
methods.description: Stops the codec and releases its resources.

methods.name: getOutputFormatChangedListener
methods.description: Retrieves the current output format changed listener.

methods.name: setOutputFormatChangedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for output format change events, along with an optional handler for callback execution.

methods.name: writeSample
methods.description: Queues a media sample (ByteBuffer) into the decoder for processing, with optional crypto info and flags.

methods.name: peekSample
methods.description: Peeks at the next available output buffer's media info without releasing it.

methods.name: popSample
methods.description: Releases the next output buffer, optionally rendering it, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Synchronizes internal buffer queues with the codec's state by dequeuing buffers and handling format changes.
